newsitem.title: USA: U.S. to sell $28 billion of 3-, 6-mo bills Nov 25.
newsitem.headline: U.S. to sell $28 billion of 3-, 6-mo bills Nov 25.

text.p: The Treasury Department said on Tuesday it will auction $28 billion of three- and six-month bills on Nov 25 to raise $1.875 billion as $26.119 billion of bills are maturing.
The weekly bill sale will be equally divided between the two maturities. The bills will be issued Nov 29. The three-month bills mature on Feb 27 and the six-month bills mature on May 29.
The CUSIP number for the three-month bills is 9127944A9 and for the six-month bills is 9127942Q7.
